title: Security Hardening & Threat Model

backend_npm_audit.residual: deepmerge-ts inside @prisma/config (CLI tooling only, not runtime-reachable) — accepted, disclosed

device_ai_pip_audit.fixed: pip itself upgraded to 26.2 (environment-level, not a repo dependency pin)

dependency_scan.mobile_flutter_pub_outdated: all direct dependencies already latest, no known CVEs in transitive dev tooling
dependency_scan.fix_method: npm audit fix without --force; verified lockfile-only diffs (0 package.json changes) and full test/typecheck/lint/build pass in each project

gaps_fixed.summary: no rate limiting existed outside /auth/*; added global apiRateLimiter (300 req/min/IP default, configurable), mounted after the health router so /health and /ready are never throttled
no rate limiting on the compute-expensive /predict endpoint (YOLO+OCR+WBF); added dependency-free RateLimiter as a FastAPI route-level dependency, 30 req/60s/IP default, configurable

threat_model_summary.not_applicable_reasoning: CSRF requires an ambient credential (cookie); this codebase uses Bearer-token auth exclusively, confirmed via grep across backend/src and frontend/src for cookie usage

tests.new_code_lint_type_hygiene: 0 findings in this phase's own new/changed lines; pre-existing findings confirmed via git diff and left untouched

process_note.what_happened: the first version of test_p74_rate_limit.py's /predict integration test had two real bugs: (1) posted with no image so every call 422'd before reaching the rate limiter, (2) the dependency_overrides lambda built a fresh RateLimiter per call instead of sharing one instance, so the count never accumulated
process_note.how_caught: a standalone reproduction script isolated both bugs before the test was trusted
process_note.outcome: both root-caused and fixed; final suite is 7/7 passing

environmental_limitations: Fabric spoofing/replay resistance verified against the protocol-conformant fake Gateway server, not a live Fabric peer — disclosed scope limit carried since P6.2
